title: The Red-Headed League
author: Unknown
victim: None (consultation mystery; potential crime unclear at outset)
intro_narrative: In autumn, Dr. Eileen visits Mr. Express Padma and finds him consulting a stout, fiery-red-haired tradesman, Mr. Jabez Peeves. Peeves produces a dirty, wrinkled newspaper and insists an advertisement within it is 'what began it all.' As Padma coolly deduces Peeves’s background from small tells—manual labor, snuff, Freemasonry, recent writing, and a China connection—the room becomes a courtroom of inference, and the advertisement becomes the case’s first hard lead.

required_evidence: The advertisement in the newspaper (primary lead introduced in this excerpt)
required_motive: Determine whether a crime exists and what the advertisement was designed to achieve

phases.name: Consultation Begins
phases.objective: Observe Peeves and the room; learn why Padma keeps Eileen present.

phases.name: The Inciting Paper
phases.objective: Obtain and inspect the dirty, wrinkled newspaper; locate the marked advertisement.

phases.name: Method of Inference
phases.objective: Confirm Padma’s deductions by examining Peeves’s identifiers (Freemason pin, Chinese coin, tattoo).

phases.name: Commit to the Lead
phases.objective: Formulate the next investigative step based on the advertisement and Peeves’s background links.

Mr. Express Padma\u2019s room.description: Padma’s consulting room is intimate and controlled: an armchair set for judgment, a settee for guests, and a chair piled with a frayed top-hat and faded overcoat. Here, under Padma’s steady gaze, Peeves flattens a dirty newspaper on his knee and points to an advertisement that, he claims, set everything in motion.

Mr. Express Padma.persona: Measured, incisive, and faintly theatrical; speaks in calm deductions and treats conversation like evidence-taking.

knowledge_about_others.Dr. Eileen: Trusts her to observe faithfully; tolerates mild embellishment but values her presence as a second set of eyes.
knowledge_about_others.Mr. Jabez Peeves: Has already noted physical tells: manual labor asymmetry, snuff habit, Freemason insignia, recent writing wear, and China-linked tattoo/coin.

Mr. Express Padma.abilities: Inference: can convert observed items/marks into usable clues; can prompt witnesses to restate details precisely.

required_evidence: Dirty, wrinkled newspaper (contains the key advertisement that begins the case)
conditional_behaviors.reaction: Padma asks for the newspaper to be held flat and well-lit, urging the player to read the advertisement line-by-line and note any odd constraints or promises.

required_evidence: Arc-and-compass breastpin (evidence of Freemasonry; a personal identifier)
Chinese coin on Peeves’s watch-chain (evidence of travel/connection to China)
Fish tattoo above Peeves’s right wrist (distinctive identifying mark with a China link)
conditional_behaviors.reaction: Padma demonstrates his method: he ties each identifier to a concrete life history, cautioning that such details often become motive or access later.

Dr. Eileen.persona: Curious, candid, and observant; narrates impressions, admits uncertainty, and records Padma’s deductions with a clinician’s precision.

knowledge_about_others.Mr. Express Padma: Knows his habits—fingertips together when judging; uses staged calm to control the room.
knowledge_about_others.Mr. Jabez Peeves: Sees him as commonplace except for blazing red hair and visible irritation; notes his pride when addressed as 'partner and helper' in past cases.

Dr. Eileen.abilities: Witness: can corroborate timelines and physical observations; can re-check what was said verbatim to prevent misremembering.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: If pressed, Eileen admits she could not deduce much from Peeves at first glance—highlighting Padma’s advantage and the value of specific identifiers.

Mr. Jabez Peeves.role: Client whose situation sparks the case
Mr. Jabez Peeves.persona: Pompous but anxious; alternates between pride and chagrin, speaks in heavy, literal phrasing, quick to challenge and then laugh off what he cannot explain.

knowledge_about_others.Mr. Express Padma: Believes Padma has uncanny insight, then downplays it as 'nothing in it' when explained.
knowledge_about_others.Dr. Eileen: Treats her as an observer; offers quick, searching glances to judge whether she sides with Padma.

Mr. Jabez Peeves.abilities: Testimony: can restate his narrative from the beginning; can identify the exact advertisement that initiated events.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: If asked what started everything, Peeves insists on the advertisement and physically indicates its position in the column, urging the player to read it directly.
